description_sq:
Vile 3+1+3. 3 kateshe me nje kate nentoke (garazhd). Ne Mjull Bathore. Vend parkimi per dy makina. Vend per ashensor ne te gjitha katet. Hapsire e bollshme, per familje te madhe, me oborr dhe verande personale qe mund te behet pishine. 
Cmimi 700.000 euro
description_en: Villa 3+1+3. 3 floors with a basement (garage). In Mjull Bathore. Parking place for two cars. Place for elevator on all floors. Ample space, for a large family, with a personal yard and veranda that can be used as a swimming pool. The price is 700,000 euros
